name: Sprinkle's Secret Ingredient
summary: In Gadgetzan, Sprinkle offers a way to make Marin Noggenfogger's foul brew drinkable with a Violet Tragan. The mushroom grows underwater in a small lake in the Hinterlands.

sections.title: A Cook's Secret
sections.body: As a child, Sprinkle's sister did all the cooking, and the food was hard to stomach. Sprinkle found a mushroom called the Violet Tragan and made it her secret ingredient. She says it made every dish taste wonderful. Now she will use it to make Marin's horrid brew drinkable.

sections.title: Under the Water
sections.body: The Violet Tragan grows underwater in a small lake in the Hinterlands. Valorwind Lake lies just south of the road that crosses the zone. Dive beneath the surface to gather the mushroom, then return to Sprinkle in Gadgetzan.

faq.answer: Sprinkle is a cook in Gadgetzan and a friend of Marin Noggenfogger. Marin sent you to her with a bad-tasting brew.
The Violet Tragan is a mushroom Sprinkle found as a child and calls her secret ingredient. She says it makes anything taste great.

faq.q: Where can the Violet Tragan be found?
faq.answer: The Violet Tragan grows underwater in a small lake in the Hinterlands. Valorwind Lake lies just south of the road across the zone.

faq.q: How does this connect to Marin Noggenfogger?
faq.answer: Marin's brew tasted terrible, so Sprinkle wants the Violet Tragan to make it drinkable.
